title: Improve CSV rerun review UI
summary: Upgraded the Queue CSV Rerun review UI with a compact preview header, lifecycle/run evidence card, backend-field row identity stacks, category chips, typed-path open-action copy, and responsive stacked preview rows.
reason: Operators need the CSV rerun review surface to show selected CSV state, parse/preview counts, row identity, category blockers/warnings, run evidence, and exact next actions without shifting media policy or mutation authority into the frontend.
behavior_before: CSV rerun preview showed summary text and a table whose row identity was mostly source_path, with open buttons relying on backend rejection for typed non-candidate paths and narrow layouts that could hide the reason column.
behavior_after: CSV rerun preview shows a review header, lifecycle evidence, backend-provided row identity details, category chips, explicit backend-known open-action disabled state, and stacked narrow rows that keep identity and reason visible.
tests_added: Expanded static WebView tests for CSV rerun review header, lifecycle evidence, category chips, accessible labels, and open-action copy.

Expanded browser/Node WebView smoke coverage for rendered CSV rerun counts, lifecycle evidence, row identity, category chips, open-action disabled/enabled states, and no /api/rerun/start POST during preview.
